021import org.apache.juneau.http.*;

029/**
030 * Mixin that serves the first-party rich-view runtime assets &mdash; {@code juneau-views.js},
031 * {@code juneau-ribbon.js}, {@code juneau-renders.js}, {@code juneau-views.css}, the opt-in
032 * {@code juneau-regions.js} region-populate runtime, the opt-in {@code juneau-config.js}/{@code juneau-config.css}
033 * column-chooser runtime &mdash; each at its stable path, plus deprecated compatibility mounts
034 * for the two assets that have since moved to the widget module.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * Compose into a host resource via {@link Rest#mixins() @Rest(mixins=ViewsMixin.class)}; the asset URLs then become
038 * available alongside the host's own endpoints, so browser pages can load the runtime without the application hosting
039 * it itself.  This mirrors the sibling {@code DataTablesMixin}/{@code ConsoleChromeMixin} serving pattern (those
040 * modules are not dependencies of this one, so they are not linked here).
041 *
042 * <h5 class='section'>What this ships (and what it deliberately does not):</h5>
043 * <p>
044 * Juneau's jars don't copy the <a class="doclink" href="https://datatables.net">DataTables</a> library or jQuery.  Only
045 * the thin, first-party runtime is served here; the DataTables, jQuery and Buttons files come from the WebJars that
046 * {@code juneau-console-datatables} declares, served by {@code WebJarsMixin}.  The
047 * base {@code juneau-views.css} {@code .tag} chip is dependency-free (neutral, no colors); {@code console-ui}'s
048 * {@code chrome.css} themes the same {@code .tag.<domain>.<value>} classes when present, but this module takes
049 * <b>no</b> dependency on it.
050 *
051 * <h5 class='section'>Relocated: two assets now ship in the widget module</h5>
052 * <p>
053 * {@code juneau-calendar.js} and {@code juneau-calendar.css} are widget runtimes, not
054 * table runtimes, and their bytes now live in {@code juneau-console-widgets} beside the bean contracts that
055 * drive them.  {@link WidgetsMixin} is where a new application gets them.
056 *
057 * <p>
058 * This mixin keeps a <b>deprecated</b> mount and path constant for each of the two so that an existing
059 * {@code @Rest(mixins=ViewsMixin.class)} application keeps working with no change: the mount reads the widget
060 * module's bytes off the classpath (that module is a compile-scope dependency of this one) rather than holding a
061 * second copy, so the body and the cache-buster are identical to what {@link WidgetsMixin} serves.  Composing both
062 * mixins is therefore harmless.
063 *
064 * <p>
065 * The relocation does <b>not</b> make that script standalone: it still resolves glyphs through this module's
066 * {@code juneau-icons.js} and pushes its popovers onto the ONE shared layer stack {@code juneau-views.js} publishes.
067 * A page loading the widget calendar runtime must still load this module's {@code juneau-icons.js} and
068 * {@code juneau-views.js} first.
069 *
070 * <h5 class='section'>Cache-busting + versioned URLs:</h5>
071 * <p>
072 * Each asset is served with a one-day {@code Cache-Control} and referenced from a page's {@code head=} block with a
073 * {@code ?v=<buildVersion>-<hash8>} cache-buster (see {@link #viewAssetUrl(String)}, or
074 * {@link #viewAssetUrl(RestRequest, String)} for a template-rendered consumer that needs the URL already resolved
075 * to an absolute, browser-fetchable form), where {@code hash8} is an
076 * 8-hex-char CRC32 of that asset's own served bytes, computed once and cached (classpath resources never change
077 * within a running JVM). Keying the buster off content rather than {@code buildVersion} alone matters for
078 * {@code -SNAPSHOT} builds: that version string is stable across dev rebuilds, so a version-only buster would keep
079 * serving a browser's stale cached copy after every rebuild - the content hash changes the instant the bytes do,
080 * with no SNAPSHOT special-casing needed. {@code buildVersion} is the framework's
081 * {@link Package#getImplementationVersion() implementation version}, falling back to {@code "dev"} when running from an
082 * unpackaged (IDE/test) classpath.  The served endpoint ignores the query string, so any (or no) {@code ?v=} still
083 * resolves to the same asset.
084 *
085 * <h5 class='section'>Contract-version handshake:</h5>
086 * <p>
087 * {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION} is the single wire-contract discriminator for a {@code VIEW_META} sidecar.
088 * {@code juneau-views.js} bakes in the same value so the client can fail loud when a served sidecar's
089 * {@code contractVersion} differs from the runtime's.
090 *
091 * <h5 class='section'>Mixin-only deployment:</h5>
092 * <p>
093 * The mount paths are pinned at the op level by {@code @RestGet(path=...)} on the serving methods; a class-level
094 * {@code @Rest(paths=...)} would be silently ignored under the mixin pattern.
095 *
096 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5>
097 * <ul>
098 *    <li class='jc'>{@link ViewTable}
099 * </ul>
100 *
101 * @since 10.0.0
102 */
103// @formatter:off
104@Rest
105@SuppressWarnings({
106   "java:S1133" // Still referenced externally (compatibility mount, forRemoval=false); removal is a separate deprecation-cycle decision.
107})
108public class ViewsMixin {
109
110   /**
111    * The URL path at which the client initializer is served (relative to the host mount).  A page with any
112    * datatables card must load {@code juneau-datatables.js} ({@link #DATATABLES_JS_PATH}) <b>before</b> this script,
113    * so {@code window.JuneauDataTables} is already present when {@code buildOptions} wires up that card's ajax.
114    * This mixin does not serve {@code juneau-datatables.js} itself &mdash; the resource
115    * mixes in {@code DataTablesMixin} for that, the same way it already mixes in {@code ViewsMixin} for this
116    * script; a duplicate {@code @RestGet} for the same path on two mixed-in classes would fail route
117    * registration.  A missing {@code window.JuneauDataTables} when a server-side table initializes fails loudly (console warning,
118    * no silent GET fallback) rather than silently misbehaving.  A page with any ribbon options should likewise load
119    * {@code juneau-ribbon.js} before this script, so {@code window.JuneauViews.ribbon} is present when
120    * {@code buildOptions} merges that view's active ribbon state into the request; unlike the
121    * {@code JuneauDataTables} case this one degrades rather than fails &mdash; a missing
122    * {@code window.JuneauViews.ribbon} warns and simply contributes no ribbon filters, since a view with no ribbon
123    * configured never needed {@code juneau-ribbon.js} loaded at all.
124    */
125   public static final String VIEWS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-views.js";
126
127   /**
128    * The URL path of the DataTables glue script, {@code juneau-datatables.js} (the same path as
129    * {@link DataTablesMixin#GLUE_PATH}).
130    *
131    * <p>
132    * Named here so {@link #viewAssetUrl(RestRequest, String)} can build its cache-busted URL, and so the console's
133    * {@code "datatables-glue"} toolkit pack can name the path without importing the datatables package
134    * ({@code juneau-console-freemarker} forbids that import; see its {@code ModuleGraph_ImportScan_Test}).  This mixin does
135    * <b>not</b> serve it (see {@link #VIEWS_JS_PATH} for why); {@link DataTablesMixin} does.  On a console page the
136    * {@code "datatables-glue"} toolkit pack emits it for every {@code type="datatables"} card, client or server mode,
137    * after jQuery and DataTables and before {@code juneau-views.js}.  A host with datatables cards composes
138    * {@link DataTablesMixin} and {@code WebJarsMixin}.
139    *
140    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
141    * <p class='bjava'>
142    *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(mixins={ViewsMixin.<jk>class</jk>, DataTablesMixin.<jk>class</jk>, WebJarsMixin.<jk>class</jk>})
143    *    <jk>public class</jk> MyResource <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServlet {
144    *       <jc>// Emitted by the "datatables-glue" pack before juneau-views.js:</jc>
145    *       <jc>//   ViewsMixin.viewAssetUrl(req, ViewsMixin.DATATABLES_JS_PATH)</jc>
146    *    }
147    * </p>
148    */
149   public static final String DATATABLES_JS_PATH = DataTablesMixin.GLUE_PATH;
150
151   /** The URL path at which the ribbon runtime is served (relative to the host mount). */
152   public static final String RIBBON_JS_PATH = "/juneau-ribbon.js";
153
154   /** The URL path at which the renderer registry is served (relative to the host mount). */
155   public static final String RENDERS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-renders.js";
156
157   /** The URL path at which the base view stylesheet is served (relative to the host mount). */
158   public static final String VIEWS_CSS_PATH = "/juneau-views.css";
159
160   /**
161    * The URL path at which the icon registry is served (relative to the host mount).
162    *
163    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
164    * <p class='bjava'>
165    *    <jc>// Page-level sprite layers, read once before the chrome draws:</jc>
166    *    <jc>// &lt;script src="/views/juneau-icons.js"</jc>
167    *    <jc>//         data-juneau-icon-replacement="/my/set.svg"</jc>
168    *    <jc>//         data-juneau-icon-override="/my/overrides.svg"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</jc>
169    * </p>
170    */
171   public static final String ICONS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-icons.js";
172
173   /**
174    * The URL path at which the column-search engine is served (relative to the host mount).  This
175    * dependency-free {@code <script>} loads before {@code juneau-views.js} (like the icon registry): it publishes
176    * {@code JuneauViews.search} &mdash; the client mirror of the server-side {@link SearchExpressionParser}/
177    * {@link SearchOperatorSet}/{@link InMemoryBeanQueryContext} context that the header search popup and a client-mode
178    * grid use to parse and evaluate each column's raw search expression.
179    */
180   public static final String SEARCH_JS_PATH = "/juneau-search.js";
181
182   /**
183    * The URL path at which the general page-state store is served (relative to the host mount).  This
184    * dependency-free {@code <script>} loads before {@code juneau-views.js} and {@code juneau-config.js} (like the
185    * icon registry and column-search engine): it publishes {@code JuneauViews.pageState} &mdash; a per-table /
186    * per-page key/value store, backed by {@code localStorage} by default and degrading to a silent no-op when
187    * browser storage is blocked.  The datatable View Settings dialog and any other page preference share it.
188    */
189   public static final String PAGESTATE_JS_PATH = "/juneau-pagestate.js";
190
191   /**
192    * The URL path at which the shareable "Copy link" URL-state codec is served (relative to the host mount).  This
193    * dependency-free {@code <script>} loads before {@code juneau-views.js} and {@code juneau-config.js} (like the
194    * icon registry, column-search engine, and page-state store): it publishes {@code JuneauViews.urlState} &mdash;
195    * the single codec for the one {@code ?state=} query parameter that carries a shareable link's live tab, primary-
196    * table filters, and primary-table sort (never the browser-local View Settings, and never nested tables).
197    */
198   public static final String URLSTATE_JS_PATH = "/juneau-urlstate.js";
199
200   /**
201    * The URL path at which the in-page message bus is served (relative to the host mount).  This dependency-free
202    * {@code <script>} publishes {@code JuneauViews.bus} &mdash; topic declare/claim, publish/subscribe with optional
203    * retention, and the frame and source bridges &mdash; and it <b>must</b> load before {@code juneau-views.js},
204    * {@code juneau-regions.js} and {@code juneau-console.js}, all of which read it.  The {@code "views"} toolkit pack
205    * lists it first.  A page that wires topics without it fails loud with {@code E-JS-46}.
206    *
207    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
208    * <p class='bjava'>
209    *    <jc>// A hand-written page head that does not use the "views" toolkit pack: the bus goes first.</jc>
210    *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>bus</jv> = ViewsMixin.<jsm>viewAssetUrl</jsm>(<jv>req</jv>, ViewsMixin.<jsf>BUS_JS_PATH</jsf>);
211    *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>views</jv> = ViewsMixin.<jsm>viewAssetUrl</jsm>(<jv>req</jv>, ViewsMixin.<jsf>VIEWS_JS_PATH</jsf>);
212    *    <jc>// &lt;script src="${bus}"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;&lt;script src="${views}"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</jc>
213    * </p>
214    */
215   public static final String BUS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-bus.js";
216
217   /**
218    * The URL path at which the shared SVG symbol sprite is served (relative to the host mount).
219    * {@code juneau-icons.js} fetches this next to itself by default (pack {@code original}); the key/legend
220    * file is not served to browsers.  An app replaces part or all of this shipped set per page with a replacement
221    * and/or override sprite that uses the same {@code juneau-sym-{stem}} symbol ids.
222    *
223    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
224    * <p class='bjava'>
225    *    <jc>// Page-level sprite layers, read once before the chrome draws:</jc>
226    *    <jc>// &lt;script src="/views/juneau-icons.js"</jc>
227    *    <jc>//         data-juneau-icon-replacement="/my/set.svg"</jc>
228    *    <jc>//         data-juneau-icon-override="/my/overrides.svg"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</jc>
229    * </p>
230    */
231   public static final String SYMBOLS_SVG_PATH = "/juneau-symbols.svg";
232
233   /**
234    * The URL path at which the opt-in Material Symbols Outlined sprite is served (relative to the host mount).
235    * Selected as the legacy replacement layer by {@code JuneauViews.icons.pack("material")} /
236    * {@code data-juneau-icon-pack="material"}; new apps point {@code data-juneau-icon-replacement} /
237    * {@code JuneauViews.icons.sprites({replacementUrl})} at the set they want instead.
238    * Default remains {@link #SYMBOLS_SVG_PATH} (Juneau's own shipped set).  The Material pack loads as the replacement
239    * layer on top of that shipped sprite, so stems the Material file does not carry fall back to the shipped glyph.
240    *
241    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
242    * <p class='bjava'>
243    *    <jc>// Opt in to the Material Symbols sprite as the replacement layer over the shipped set, before the chrome draws:</jc>
244    *    <jc>// &lt;script src="/views/juneau-icons.js" data-juneau-icon-pack="material"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</jc>
245    *    <jc>// or, from script before first paint:</jc>
246    *    <jc>// JuneauViews.icons.pack("material");</jc>
247    * </p>
248    */
249   public static final String SYMBOLS_MATERIAL_SVG_PATH = "/juneau-symbols-material.svg";
250
251   /**
252    * The URL path at which the opt-in region-populate runtime is served (relative to the host mount).  A page with
253    * no {@code data-juneau-region} element never needs to load it.
254    *
255    * <h5 class='section'>Load order is a contract, not a preference:</h5>
256    * <p>
257    * This {@code <script>} MUST come after {@code juneau-views.js}.  The region runtime publishes onto the same
258    * {@code window.JuneauViews} namespace that {@code juneau-views.js} creates, and reuses that runtime's
259    * {@code renderAsyncStatus} status renderer rather than defining one of its own.
260    */
261   public static final String REGIONS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-regions.js";
262
263   /**
264    * The URL path at which the opt-in region-populate paint library is served (relative to the host mount).  A
265    * page of purely custom regions (every populate hand-writes its own DOM) never needs to load it.
266    *
267    * <h5 class='section'>Load order is a contract, not a preference:</h5>
268    * <p>
269    * This {@code <script>} MUST come after {@code juneau-regions.js} (itself after {@code juneau-views.js}).
270    * {@code fieldGrid}'s renderer dispatch reads the renderer registry {@code juneau-views.js} publishes and its
271    * markdown/sanitized-HTML paths reuse that runtime's allowlist copiers, and {@code ctx.helpers}
272    * (a bare pass-through of this asset's exports) is a field of the {@code ctx} {@code juneau-regions.js} freezes.
273    */
274   public static final String HELPERS_JS_PATH = "/juneau-helpers.js";
275
276   /**
277    * [GET] path of the DataRegistry runtime ({@code JuneauViews.data}): the frames behind {@code data:} bus topics.
278    * Loaded after {@link #BUS_JS_PATH}; the {@code "data"} toolkit pack serves it.
279    */
280   public static final String DATA_JS_PATH = "/juneau-data.js";
281
282   /**
283    * The URL path at which the opt-in terminal-view module is served (relative to the host mount).
284    *
285    * <h5 class='section'>Load order is a contract, not a preference:</h5>
286    * <p>
287    * This {@code <script>} MUST come after {@code juneau-regions.js} (itself after {@code juneau-views.js}) and
288    * before {@code juneau-helpers.js}.  It registers its populator with {@code juneau-regions.js} at load time;
289    * icons are built through {@code JuneauViews.helpers.icon}, which is resolved at call time, so loading before
290    * {@code juneau-helpers.js} is safe.
291    *
292    * @since 10.0.0
293    */
294   public static final String RUN_VIEW_JS_PATH = "/juneau-terminal-view.js";
295
296   /**
297    * The URL path at which the opt-in column-chooser runtime is served (relative to the host mount).  A
298    * consumer adds this {@code <script>} after {@code juneau-views.js}; a non-configurable table never loads it.
299    */
300   public static final String CONFIG_JS_PATH = "/juneau-config.js";
301
302   /**
303    * The URL path at which the opt-in column-chooser stylesheet is served (relative to the host mount).
304    */
305   public static final String CONFIG_CSS_PATH = "/juneau-config.css";
306
307   /**
308    * The URL path at which the opt-in reusable-calendar runtime is served (relative to the host mount).  A page
309    * with no calendar never loads it.
310    *
311    * <h5 class='section'>Load order is a contract, not a preference:</h5>
312    * <p>
313    * This {@code <script>} MUST come after {@code juneau-views.js}.  The calendar's {@code "+N more"} popover is
314    * pushed onto the ONE shared layer stack that {@code juneau-views.js} publishes, so that Escape, focus return
315    * and z-order are the same as every other layer in the page.  The calendar deliberately defines no second
316    * stack of its own: if the shared one is absent it fails loud (console error plus a visible in-cell refusal)
317    * rather than quietly opening a popover nothing can dismiss.
318    *
319    * @deprecated The calendar runtime now ships in the widget module; compose
320    *    {@link WidgetsMixin} and use its constant of the same name.  This one
321    *    remains only so that an application composing this mixin alone keeps serving the asset at the same URL.
322    */
323   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
324   public static final String CALENDAR_JS_PATH = "/juneau-calendar.js";
325
326   /**
327    * The URL path at which the opt-in reusable-calendar stylesheet is served (relative to the host mount).
328    *
329    * @deprecated The calendar stylesheet now ships in the widget module; compose
330    *    {@link WidgetsMixin} and use its constant of the same name.  This one
331    *    remains only so that an application composing this mixin alone keeps serving the asset at the same URL.
332    */
333   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
334   public static final String CALENDAR_CSS_PATH = "/juneau-calendar.css";
335
336   /**
337    * The URL path at which the console shell runtime is served (relative to the host mount).
338    *
339    * <p>
340    * {@code juneau-console.js} mounts the C1 page contract (header, nav, cards, footer) from a page's
341    * {@code #juneau-page} script island. This module takes a compile-scope dependency on
342    * {@code juneau-console} so that a {@code views}-only application can serve the console shell
343    * from the same mixin it already composes, without separately adding {@link ConsoleChromeMixin}. The toolkit
344    * pack ({@code juneau-views.js} and siblings) deliberately does <b>not</b> bundle this script: a console page's
345    * shell loads it once via {@code PageCapture.writeBody}, and a second copy from the toolkit pack would
346    * double-load the runtime.
347    *
348    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
349    * <p class='bjava'>
350    *    <jc>// A views-only application serves the console shell at the same stable (unprefixed) path ConsoleChromeMixin serves it at.</jc>
351    *    <ja>&#64;Rest</ja>(mixins=ViewsMixin.<jk>class</jk>)
352    *    <jk>public class</jk> MyResource {}
353    *
354    *    <jc>// GET /juneau-console.js now returns the shell runtime.</jc>
355    * </p>
356    */
357   public static final String CONSOLE_JS_PATH = ConsoleChromeMixin.CONSOLE_JS_PATH_UNPREFIXED;

364    * Templates never author {@code view.contractVersion}: the framework stamps this value when it lifts the catalog,

366    * {@code ConsoleTemplateValidator}'s {@code view-contract-version} rule flags a literal pin statically.
367    */

374    */

380    */
381   public static final String BAR_CONTRACT_VERSION = "1";

387    */
388   public static final String SLOT_CONTRACT_VERSION = "1";

471    * Read+cache+hash+serve helper for this mixin's shipped assets, anchored on this class so

477   /**
478    * The same helper, but anchored on the <b>widget</b> mixin, for the two assets that module now ships and this
479    * one only keeps deprecated mounts for.
480    *
481    * <p>
482    * The anchor governs two things: which classpath the bytes are read from (irrelevant here &mdash; the widget
483    * module is a compile-scope dependency, so either anchor finds the same bytes) and which module's
484    * implementation version the {@code ?v=<buildVersion>-<hash8>} cache-buster carries.  Anchoring the relocated
485    * two on the widget mixin makes this mixin's deprecated URL for an asset <b>byte-identical</b> to the widget
486    * mixin's URL for it, buster included, rather than merely serving the same body behind two differently-versioned
487    * URLs.  A page that mixes both mixins therefore cannot end up caching the same script twice.
488    */

762   /**
763    * Returns the servlet-relative URL for a served asset, carrying a {@code ?v=<buildVersion>-<hash8>} content-
764    * sensitive cache-buster suitable for a page's {@code head=} block (see the class Javadoc's cache-busting
765    * section for why the buster is content- rather than purely version-keyed).
766    *
767    * @param path One of the asset path constants ({@link #VIEWS_JS_PATH}, {@link #RIBBON_JS_PATH},
768    *    {@link #BUS_JS_PATH}, {@link #RENDERS_JS_PATH}, {@link #VIEWS_CSS_PATH}, {@link #ICONS_JS_PATH}, {@link #SYMBOLS_SVG_PATH},
769    *    {@link #SYMBOLS_MATERIAL_SVG_PATH}, {@link #REGIONS_JS_PATH}, {@link #HELPERS_JS_PATH}, {@link #DATA_JS_PATH}, {@link #RUN_VIEW_JS_PATH}, {@link #CONFIG_JS_PATH}, {@link #CONFIG_CSS_PATH},
770    *    {@link #CALENDAR_JS_PATH}, {@link #CALENDAR_CSS_PATH}, {@link #DATATABLES_JS_PATH}).
771    * @return The servlet-relative asset URL with the version+content-hash cache-buster appended.
772    */
773   public static String viewAssetUrl(String path) {
774      return "servlet:" + path + cacheFor(path).cacheBuster(resourceFor(path));
775   }
776
777   /**
778    * Returns a real, browser-fetchable <b>absolute</b> URL for a served asset, resolved against the given
779    * request's context path and mount &mdash; carrying the same {@code ?v=<buildVersion>-<hash8>} content-
780    * sensitive cache-buster as {@link #viewAssetUrl(String)} (see the class Javadoc's cache-busting section).
781    *
782    * <p>
783    * {@link #viewAssetUrl(String)} returns a {@code servlet:}-prefixed URL that only Juneau's own HTML serializer
784    * resolves (it rewrites {@code servlet:} against the request at render time). A template-rendering consumer
785    * (e.g. {@code juneau-rest-server-view-freemarker}) sits downstream of that serializer, so it never sees the
786    * rewrite and would otherwise receive the literal, unfetchable string. This overload resolves the URL itself,
787    * per-request, the same way {@code ConsoleChromeMixin.assetUrl(RestRequest, ...)} does &mdash; via
788    * {@link RestRequest#getUriResolver()} &mdash; so it is usable from any consumer, template-rendered or not.
789    *
790    * @param req The current request, supplying the context path/mount to resolve against.
791    * @param path One of the asset path constants ({@link #VIEWS_JS_PATH}, {@link #RIBBON_JS_PATH},
792    *    {@link #BUS_JS_PATH}, {@link #RENDERS_JS_PATH}, {@link #VIEWS_CSS_PATH}, {@link #ICONS_JS_PATH}, {@link #SYMBOLS_SVG_PATH},
793    *    {@link #SYMBOLS_MATERIAL_SVG_PATH}, {@link #REGIONS_JS_PATH}, {@link #HELPERS_JS_PATH}, {@link #DATA_JS_PATH}, {@link #RUN_VIEW_JS_PATH}, {@link #CONFIG_JS_PATH}, {@link #CONFIG_CSS_PATH},
794    *    {@link #CALENDAR_JS_PATH}, {@link #CALENDAR_CSS_PATH}, {@link #DATATABLES_JS_PATH}).
795    * @return The absolute asset URL with the version+content-hash cache-buster appended.
796    */
797   public static String viewAssetUrl(RestRequest req, String path) {
798      return req.getUriResolver().resolve("servlet:" + path) + cacheFor(path).cacheBuster(resourceFor(path));
799   }

852   /** Reads (and caches) the classpath asset and wraps it as a cacheable {@link HttpResource}. */
853   private static HttpResource serve(String resource, String contentType) {
854      return ASSET_CACHE.serve(resource, contentType, CACHE_CONTROL);
855   }
856
857   /**
858    * Selects the cache that owns the given asset path: the two relocated widget assets hash and version through
859    * the widget module's cache (see {@link #WIDGET_ASSET_CACHE}), the DataTables glue through the datatables
860    * module's (see {@link #DATATABLES_ASSET_CACHE}), everything else through this module's own.
861    */
862   private static ClasspathAssetCache cacheFor(String path) {
863      if (eqa(path, CALENDAR_JS_PATH, CALENDAR_CSS_PATH))
864         return WIDGET_ASSET_CACHE;
865      if (eq(path, DATATABLES_JS_PATH))
866         return DATATABLES_ASSET_CACHE;
867      return ASSET_CACHE;
868   }
869
870   /** Maps a public asset path constant to its classpath resource constant (content-hashing only; routing itself is by {@code @RestGet(path=...)}). */
871   @SuppressWarnings({
872      "java:S3776" // Flat path-to-resource lookup table; one branch per asset, no nesting.
873   })
874   private static String resourceFor(String path) {
875      if (eq(path, VIEWS_JS_PATH)) return VIEWS_JS_RESOURCE;
876      if (eq(path, RIBBON_JS_PATH)) return RIBBON_JS_RESOURCE;
877      if (eq(path, RENDERS_JS_PATH)) return RENDERS_JS_RESOURCE;
878      if (eq(path, VIEWS_CSS_PATH)) return VIEWS_CSS_RESOURCE;
879      if (eq(path, ICONS_JS_PATH)) return ICONS_JS_RESOURCE;
880      if (eq(path, SEARCH_JS_PATH)) return SEARCH_JS_RESOURCE;
881      if (eq(path, PAGESTATE_JS_PATH)) return PAGESTATE_JS_RESOURCE;
882      if (eq(path, URLSTATE_JS_PATH)) return URLSTATE_JS_RESOURCE;
883      if (eq(path, BUS_JS_PATH)) return BUS_JS_RESOURCE;
884      if (eq(path, SYMBOLS_SVG_PATH)) return SYMBOLS_SVG_RESOURCE;
885      if (eq(path, SYMBOLS_MATERIAL_SVG_PATH)) return SYMBOLS_MATERIAL_SVG_RESOURCE;
886      if (eq(path, REGIONS_JS_PATH)) return REGIONS_JS_RESOURCE;
887      if (eq(path, HELPERS_JS_PATH)) return HELPERS_JS_RESOURCE;
888      if (eq(path, DATA_JS_PATH)) return DATA_JS_RESOURCE;
889      if (eq(path, RUN_VIEW_JS_PATH)) return RUN_VIEW_JS_RESOURCE;
890      if (eq(path, CONFIG_JS_PATH)) return CONFIG_JS_RESOURCE;
891      if (eq(path, CONFIG_CSS_PATH)) return CONFIG_CSS_RESOURCE;
892      if (eq(path, CALENDAR_JS_PATH)) return CALENDAR_JS_RESOURCE;
893      if (eq(path, CALENDAR_CSS_PATH)) return CALENDAR_CSS_RESOURCE;
894      if (eq(path, DATATABLES_JS_PATH)) return DATATABLES_JS_RESOURCE;
895      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown asset path: " + path);
896   }
